Design · build

Eight landscaping services, one point of contact.

Most properties start with one thing — a tired lawn, a driveway, a drainage problem — and add the rest once they have seen how the first went. Every service here is handled by the same company, so the sod, the irrigation that waters it and the drainage under it are planned together.

How a landscape project runs

You see it before we dig it.

The most expensive thing in landscaping is finding out you did not want it once it is in the ground.

01

We meet, and you talk

A member of the design team meets with you to get your vision. Estimates are free.

02

You see a rendering

A rendering of the finished product, so you approve a picture of your own property.

03

We build it

Installed by the same company that designed it, to the rendering you approved.

About the design fee. Estimates are free. The only published fee is digital landscape design work: as of 7/1/2023 it is $250, with a 50% deposit, and the $250 is credited toward the landscape project if the package is approved.

Questions

Before you call.

Can you handle the whole landscape, or just one part?

Either. Take one service or all seven — design, sod, pavers, irrigation, trees and hedges, lighting and drainage are all handled by the same company.

Are estimates free?

Yes. Estimates are free. The only published fee is digital landscape design work: as of 7/1/2023 it is $250, with a 50% deposit, and the $250 is credited toward the landscape project if the package is approved.

Do you work on commercial properties?

Yes. Every landscaping service is available residential and commercial.
